description: AstroSoma unites Dağhan Dağlı (High School Student Researcher — Toros Science High School, MEV (Toros University); AI & Systems Architecture, Lexovian/WerrSoma) and Dr. Zerrin Dağlı (Ph.D., CEIT, Mersin University — Crew Learning UX & Gamification). We build open-source astronaut health monitoring aligned with NASA HRP 5 Hazards: clickable anatomy, vital trend alerts, plain guidance, and 24-byte 0-SRAM autonomous triage across ISS, Artemis, and Mars missions. Live: https://astrosoma.space/
